records.jp: あれ？<CR>みんな、何してるの？
records.en_original: Oh, hey. What's everybody up to?
records.en: Oh, hey. What's everybody up to?

records.jp: あっ、愛央ちゃん！<CR>今から、詩帆ちゃんにお料理教えてもらうんだよ！
records.en_original: Hi, Ao! We were about to have Shiho teach us how to cook!
records.en: Hi, Ao! We were about to have Shiho teach us how to cook!

records.jp: そうなの？　いいなあ。<CR>詩帆さん、お料理上手だもんね！
records.en_original: Really? That's awesome! Shiho's cooking is the best!
records.en: Really? That's awesome! Shiho's cooking is the best!

records.jp: ふふ、ありがとうございます。<CR>よかったら、星崎さんも一緒にどうですか？
records.en_original: Hehe, thank you. Would you like to join us, Ao?
records.en: Hehe, thank you. Would you like to join us, Ao?

records.jp: えっ、飛び入り参加しちゃっていいの？
records.en_original: Ooh, can I?
records.en: Ooh, can I?

records.jp: 詩帆がいいなら、私は大歓迎だよ
records.en_original: If Shiho doesn't mind, I'd love to have you here.
records.en: If Shiho doesn't mind, I'd love to have you here.

records.jp: 私も～！
records.en_original: Me too!
records.en: Me too!

records.jp: やったー！<CR>詩帆さん、みんな！　よろしくお願いしまーす！
records.en_original: Yay! Thanks for having me!
records.en: Yay! Thanks for having me!

records.jp: ええと、卵を混ぜるときは<CR>白身を切るように……
records.en_original: So, you have to beat the eggs until there are no more white streaks...
records.en: So, you have to beat the eggs until there are no more white streaks...

records.jp: そうそう、上手！
records.en_original: Yes, that's right! You're getting it!
records.en: Yes, that's right! You're getting it!

records.jp: 日菜子、上達が早いね。<CR>わたしの教えること、すぐになくなっちゃいそう
records.en_original: You learn quick, Hinako. I won't have much left to teach you at this rate.
records.en: You learn quick, Hinako. I won't have much left to teach you at this rate.

records.jp: まさか！　それに、私の上達が早いって言うなら<CR>それは詩帆の教え方が上手いんだと思うよ
records.en_original: No way! If you think I'm absorbing any of this quickly, it's all thanks to how well you teach.
records.en: No way! If you think I'm absorbing any of this quickly, it's all thanks to how well you teach.

records.jp: えーっと、次は<CR>人参を一口大に切って……
records.en_original: Let's see, cut the carrot into bite-sized chunks...
records.en: Let's see, cut the carrot into bite-sized chunks...

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん、ストップ！
records.en_original: Hiori, stop!
records.en: Hiori, stop!

records.jp: えっ！？
records.en_original: Huh?!
records.en: Huh?!

records.jp: 包丁を使うときは、<CR>猫の手、ですよ
records.en_original: You have to use the claw grip when using a knife.
records.en: You have to use the claw grip when using a knife.

records.jp: あっ！　そ、そうだった！<CR>ごめんなさい……
records.en_original: Aah! Th-that's right! Sorry, Shiho...
records.en: Aah! Th-that's right! Sorry, Shiho...

records.jp: こちらこそ、ごめんなさい。<CR>つい、大きな声を出してしまって
records.en_original: No, I'm sorry I raised my voice at you.
records.en: No, I'm sorry I raised my voice at you.

records.jp: ううん。だって、心配してくれたんだよね？<CR>ありがとう、詩帆ちゃん！
records.en_original: It's fine. You were only looking out for me. Thank you, Shiho!
records.en: It's fine. You were only looking out for me. Thank you, Shiho!

records.jp: （詩帆さん、みんなの手元をチェックしながら<CR>自分の料理も着々と進めてる……すごい！）
records.en_original: (Shiho's keeping an eye on everybody while not missing a beat with her own cooking. Amazing!)
records.en: (Shiho's keeping an eye on everybody while not missing a beat with her own cooking. Amazing!)

records.jp: って、感動してる場合じゃない！<CR>詩帆さん！　これ、次はどうすればいい？
records.en_original: But now's not the time to be staring in awe! Shiho, what do I need to do next?
records.en: But now's not the time to be staring in awe! Shiho, what do I need to do next?

records.jp: ああ、それはですね──
records.en_original: Oh, so you'll need to...
records.en: Oh, so you'll need to...

records.jp: では皆さん。<CR>手を合わせて……
records.en_original: Okay. Is everybody ready?
records.en: Okay. Is everybody ready?

records.jp: いっただっきまーす！
records.en_original: Let's eat!
records.en: Let's eat!

records.jp: んぐんぐ……おおっ！<CR>日菜子ちゃんのオムライス、卵ふわとろ～！
records.en_original: Hmng... Mmf... Wow! Hinako, your omelet rice is so good!
records.en: Hmng... Mmf... Wow! Hinako, your omelet rice is so good!

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんのカレーもめちゃうまだよ！<CR>お肉も人参もゴロゴロおっきくて、幸せ～！
records.en_original: Your curry is amazing too, Hiori! The beef and carrots make it so chunky and good!
records.en: Your curry is amazing too, Hiori! The beef and carrots make it so chunky and good!

records.jp: ん……詩帆の肉じゃがも、美味しいよ。<CR>優しい味がするね
records.en_original: Mmm... Shiho, your beef stew is delicious. It's so warm and comforting.
records.en: Mmm... Shiho, your beef stew is delicious. It's so warm and comforting.

records.jp: ふふ、ありがとう
records.en_original: Hehe, thank you.
records.en: Hehe, thank you.

records.jp: ねえねえ愛央ちゃん！<CR>愛央ちゃんは、どのお料理が一番美味しかった？
records.en_original: Ao, which meal did you like the best?
records.en: Ao, which meal did you like the best?

records.jp: えっ？　うーん、迷うなあ。<CR>でも、強いてひとつに決めるとするなら……
records.en_original: Hm? Uh, that's a tough one. But if I had to choose...
records.en: Hm? Uh, that's a tough one. But if I had to choose...

records.jp: 詩帆さんの肉じゃが、かな
records.en_original: Probably Shiho's beef stew.
records.en: Probably Shiho's beef stew.

records.jp: 日菜子さんも言っていたけど、優しくって……<CR>お母さんの味って感じがするんだよね
records.en_original: Hinako said it best, but it was so comforting. It tastes just like what my mom would make!
records.en: Hinako said it best, but it was so comforting. It tastes just like what my mom would make!

records.jp: お母さん、ですか？
records.en_original: Is that how you think of me?
records.en: Is that how you think of me?

records.jp: あ、ごめん！　嫌だった？
records.en_original: S-sorry! Was that insulting?
records.en: S-sorry! Was that insulting?

records.jp: いえいえ、そんなことないですよ。<CR>私にとっては褒め言葉です。ありがとう、星崎さん
records.en_original: No, not at all. I take it as a compliment. Thank you, Ao.
records.en: No, not at all. I take it as a compliment. Thank you, Ao.

records.jp: 日菜子さんのオムライスかな。<CR>ケチャップライスと、バター風味の卵が絶妙！
records.en_original: Probably Hinako's omelet rice. The buttery eggs totally hit the spot!
records.en: Probably Hinako's omelet rice. The buttery eggs totally hit the spot!

records.jp: 私？　……そっか。<CR>なら、お母さんに感謝しないとね
records.en_original: Mine? ...Wow. I guess I owe my mom thanks.
records.en: Mine? ...Wow. I guess I owe my mom thanks.

records.jp: お母さん？　どうして？
records.en_original: Your mom? Why's that?
records.en: Your mom? Why's that?

records.jp: オムライスは、お母さんに教えてもらったんだ
records.en_original: She's the one who taught me how to make omelet rice.
records.en: She's the one who taught me how to make omelet rice.

records.jp: いつかお嫁さんに行った時のために<CR>一つは得意料理を持ちなさい、って言われて
records.en_original: She told me I ought to know how to make at least one meal.
records.en: She told me I ought to know how to make at least one meal.

records.jp: なるほど……<CR>日菜子さんの、未来の結婚相手が羨ましい！
records.en_original: Gotcha. I'm so jealous of whoever you end up cooking for!
records.en: Gotcha. I'm so jealous of whoever you end up cooking for!

records.jp: あはは！　私も、未来の結婚相手は<CR>愛央みたいに笑顔でご飯を食べてくれる人がいいなあ
records.en_original: Ahaha! Well, as long as they eat with a smile like you do, I'll be happy!
records.en: Ahaha! Well, as long as they eat with a smile like you do, I'll be happy!

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんのカレーかなあ。<CR>食べ応えバツグン！　ついお代わりしたくなっちゃう
records.en_original: Probably Hiori's curry. I love my curry chunky! I'm gonna have to get seconds.
records.en: Probably Hiori's curry. I love my curry chunky! I'm gonna have to get seconds.

records.jp: えっ、私！？<CR>そ、そっかあ。えへへ、なんか照れるかも
records.en_original: M-me?! Ehehe, you're gonna make me blush.
records.en: M-me?! Ehehe, you're gonna make me blush.

records.jp: お母さんの味には、<CR>まだまだ及ばないけど……
records.en_original: I still have a long way to go, but...
records.en: I still have a long way to go, but...

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんにそう言ってもらえると、<CR>もっともっとガンバローって気持ちになるよ！
records.en_original: Hearing you compliment my cooking makes me want to get even better at it, Ao!
records.en: Hearing you compliment my cooking makes me want to get even better at it, Ao!

records.jp: えへへ……
records.en_original: Hehe...
records.en: Hehe...

records.jp: でもでも！　やっぱり<CR>どのお料理もすーっごく美味しかったよ
records.en_original: But every one of these dishes were soooo good!
records.en: But every one of these dishes were soooo good!

records.jp: わたしもそう思います。<CR>皆さんが頑張ってくれたおかげですね
records.en_original: I agree. You all did very well.
records.en: I agree. You all did very well.

records.jp: それと、詩帆ちゃんが教えてくれたおかげ！　ね？
records.en_original: It's thanks to your teaching, Shiho!
records.en: It's thanks to your teaching, Shiho!

records.jp: そうだね。<CR>良かったら、また教えてよ
records.en_original: It is. You should teach us again, if you don't mind.
records.en: It is. You should teach us again, if you don't mind.

records.jp: ふふ。わたしでよければ、いくらでも
records.en_original: Hehe. I'd be happy to.
records.en: Hehe. I'd be happy to.
